shared-target.body:
## Question

What recurring reference to 'shared-target' appears across episodic entries?

## Investigation

3 episodic entries reference 'shared-target':
- memory/episodic/e1.md
- memory/episodic/e2.md
- memory/episodic/e3.md

## Findings

'shared-target' recurs across 3 distinct entries (recurrence floor: 3), a deterministic signal that this is durable, not incidental.

## Lessons

Promoted episodic -> semantic (V6-4). The consolidated entry is durable (decay-exempt) and carries a derived_from provenance edge back to its 3 sources; none of those sources were deleted or modified.
